# Goal: faithfully recreate Bubble Tanks 3

Continue building a faithful, one-to-one recreation of the original Bubble Tanks 3 Flash game in `/home/ian/Projects/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank`. The intended result is an offline game whose appearance, animation, controls, sound and gameplay are indistinguishable from the original, except for explicitly documented removals and usability additions.

The reverse-engineering documentation and original implementation evidence are in `/home/ian/Projects/ianwijma/documented-bubble-tank-3`. Initial research, asset extraction and a demonstration of loading assets directly from the Flash file already exist. Consult that repository whenever functionality is uncertain. Prefer decompiled code, and inspect exported bytecode when the decompiler is ambiguous, rather than inventing behavior.

Use Bun, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS and the project's selected JavaScript game engine, PixiJS. Keep the implementation lightweight and modular so it can be tinkered with and extended without reworking whole systems. Preserve the separation between simulation, rendering and browser services. Avoid spending time on disposable prototypes when the original provides the specification.

Before entering the game, let the player supply their own Flash file. Extract the required artwork and audio locally in the browser using the existing asset-loading approach. Do not bundle or commit the SWF or extracted original media. If no Flash file is supplied, support playable mock assets. Their layouts, sizes, colors and movement should follow the recovered original designs as closely as practical.

Strip out currently broken or unavailable functionality, including retired online services, while retaining isolated stubs so those features can be added or restored later. Keep deliberate differences explicit; do not silently reinterpret the original.

Continue from the existing implementation rather than restarting. Read `AGENTS.md`, [the continuation handoff](docs/handoff.md), [the architecture](docs/architecture.md) and [the fidelity ledger](docs/fidelity.md). The ledger records implemented contracts, evidence limits and remaining work. The recreation goal is not yet complete: passing selected tests does not establish full-game parity.

Verify changes with the appropriate rule tests, browser flows and original-runtime comparisons. Keep documentation current, and occasionally commit and push verified changes using the configured signing setup. Continue until the remaining fidelity work is completed and the full offline experience has been checked against the original.
No matching skills. Continue without one.

## Observer errors and corrections

Every correction was confined to ignored observer/evidence files, and same-game continuation followed a genuinely verified public Paused checkpoint. `observer-changes.md` and copied prior/current script versions preserve history; each segment JSON includes controller/classifier/worker/pickup-policy SHA-256.

1. Initial review enlarged the player exclusion to125 world-pixel radius (62.5 screenshot pixels at50% zoom). Inspected Infiltrator screenshots fit entirely inside it. Recovery/inner exploration followed. Later confirmed pauses expanded radius4.2, then5.2 as nearby fields became exhausted. Public map-dot clearance is a heuristic; accidental combat crossings and revisits still occurred.
4. A screenshot during segment4 showed an outlined gold-bodied enemy absent from the blue-body-only target list, with the observer firing elsewhere. Segment4 requested normal loop exit by SIGTERM (not browser/server kill), released inputs and confirmed Paused at02:18:44.722UTC. Added enclosed gold-body centroids to the screenshot classifier and resumed the same game. The prior classifier is saved as `pixels-before-gold.py`; `observer-gold-repair-request.json` identifies the stopped controller. This was an observer mistake, not evidence of a game defect.
5. After segment5's Paused checkpoint, movement remained held through screenshot-analysis latency to reduce the earlier stop/start exposure; transition/dialog/checkpoint releases remain. The observer would prefer Heavy Seeker if actually offered, otherwise the first card. No such second offer occurred, so that preference was never exercised.
6. After segment6's Paused checkpoint, a visible combat target took priority over nearby pickup steering. The observer still aims/fires and collects using public controls.

Repeated damage, missed gold-body recognition, accidental crossings and route revisits limit the observer's performance. They do not establish a production simulation bug. The latest healthy phase was ordinary active combat/collection in the final segment, followed by actual public Paused. Further progress needs a more capable public-input pilot or human-controlled continuation in a fresh session; a concrete defect claim needs reproducible public evidence and a separate source/original diagnosis. No production fix was attempted.

from pathlib import Path
import json,time,hashlib
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
import numpy as np
from silhouette import fit
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ex=json.loads((R/'extraction.json').read_text());results=[];started=time.monotonic()
for window in ex['windows']:
 folder=R/Path(window['landmark']['path']).stem;rows=[]
 for p in sorted(folder.glob('frame-*.png')):
  t=time.perf_counter();mask,row=fit(p);row.update(frame=p.name,frameSha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),analysisSeconds=time.perf_counter()-t);rows.append(row)
 (folder/'fits.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\\n')
 # Predeclared source-time indices, selected without detector scores.
 chosen=[5,10,15,20,25,30];raw=Image.new('RGB',(900,600));overlay=Image.new('RGB',(900,600))
 for i,index in enumerate(chosen):
  p=folder/f'frame-{index:03d}.png';a=Image.open(p).convert('RGB');mask,row=fit(p);b=np.array(a);b[mask]=(b[mask]*.55+np.array([255,0,255])*.45).astype('uint8');b=Image.fromarray(b)
  for canvas,img in [(raw,a),(overlay,b)]:
   crop=img.crop((200,150,350,300)).resize((300,300),Image.Resampling.NEAREST);canvas.paste(crop,((i%3)*300,(i//3)*300));ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text(((i%3)*300+4,(i//3)*300+4),f'frame{index} +{index/20:.2f}s',fill='white')
 raw.save(folder/'predeclared-raw.png');overlay.save(folder/'predeclared-fit.png')
 results.append({'window':folder.name,'frames':len(rows),'meanEdgeDistance':{'min':min(r['meanEdgeDistance'] for r in rows),'max':max(r['meanEdgeDistance'] for r in rows)},'edgeWithin1_5':{'min':min(r['edgeWithin1_5'] for r in rows),'max':max(r['edgeWithin1_5'] for r in rows)},'reviewIndices':chosen})
(R/'video-fit-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'results':results,'elapsedSeconds':time.monotonic()-started,'scope':'Reference-conditioned pixel fit only; no calibrated live ownership, frame-time or ordinary completion claim.'},indent=2)+'\\n');print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
